reader.requirement: FUNCTION MEDIAN returns, for an odd count of referenced occurrences, a value with at least half the occurrences on each side, and for an even count the arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted occurrences, the parity being that of the run-time occurrence count (an ODO ALL range included).

edition-consulted.switches: the function's IntroducedIn (85 for MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN) against DialectLevel: COBOL1502 before it
construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function written where an identifier stands is refused (COBOL0900); inside an arithmetic expression it is not consulted
OPTIONS ARITHMETIC mode; at 85 no ARITHMETIC clause exists so Options.Arithmetic is Native, the latest edition's default arm

reader.edition-search: grep of Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior over IntrinsicRenderer.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs, CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs, CobolIntrinsics.Dec.cs, CobolIntrinsics.ExactValue.cs and CobolTable.cs found none on the MAX/MEAN/MEDIAN arms; the edition is read only in IntrinsicBinder (availability window, identifier-placement screen, argument predicates) and through the arithmetic mode
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf05_06 covers literal lists and a fixed 3-element ALL with odd and even counts; not exercised there are a parity fixed only at run time by an ODO object, negative and 18-digit middle pairs, and a sum of the middle pair beyond 18 digits (probed here)

probes.printed: COBOL0900 floating-point numeric literal 1.5E1 requires COBOL-2002 (lines 9, 11, 12); COBOL0900 national literal N"AB" requires COBOL-2002 plus COBOL1627 class mismatch (line 10)
probes.expected: a floating-point literal argument (2002) is refused at --std 85

OK  §1989:A.2.2 AR4  (2.2 ARGUMENTS**)  the text is in AR4

reader.notes: The parity is decided at run time on the expanded argument array (D1..D4 vary the ODO object 5, 4, 2, 1 in one program), and the even branch adds the two middles with checked ExactAdd before the exact x5 halving, so D7's 19-digit pair sum is exact. Same output at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: Even counts: meanctx2-001 C4 COMPUTE PIC 9 ROUNDED = MEDIAN (1 2) gives 2, C5 MEDIAN (1 2) * 2 gives 3, C7 IF MEDIAN (W1 PIC 9V9 .1, W2 PIC 9V99 .02) = 0.06 true (mean of two middles of different scales in a receiverless context), CB MEDIAN (TE (ALL)) of 4 elements = 1.0, CG MEDIAN (K K 0 K) = K, CK = 2.5; degen-001 G5 MEDIAN (W-N W-N) = -1.25. meanprec2-001 P2 MEDIAN (K F) into PIC 9(18) gives 499999999999999999 and P6 IF MEDIAN (K F) < 500000000000000000 true: the 37-digit mean of the middle pair is kept exactly. Same at --std 2023 (meanprec2-002). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.25.4 RV2 'the returned value is the arithmetic mean of the values referenced by the two middle occurrences'.
